stories.title: Implement Explainability Core Logic Builder
stories.description: Create a shared utility/service that constructs explainability objects (source, meaning, limitations) from raw signal inputs, ensuring consistent phrasing and fallback handling when data is incomplete.

stories.title: Add Limitations and Confidence Heuristics
stories.description: Implement logic to populate the limitations field dynamically based on data source (e.g., NPI, ClinicalTrials.gov) and known gaps such as outdated records, incomplete eligibility, or missing verification.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
stories.description: Update chat UI message rendering to display explainability information (source, meaning, limitations) in a readable format within MessageBubble, ensuring safe markdown rendering and alignment with conversational UX.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Explainability Schema and Builder
stories.description: Add unit tests validating schema enforcement and correctness of explainability object generation, including edge cases for missing or partial data.
